# Urban Craft & Co. Catalogue Browser Skill

This skill allows agents to search products, look up SKUs, and match employee onboarding needs to specific combinations.

## Core Categories

- **2-in-1 through 7-in-1 Gift Sets:** Curated boxes pairing writing instruments, vacuum bottles, power banks, and desk accessories.
- **Employee Welcome Kits:** Practical onboarding essentials engineered for new hires on day one.
- **Bottles & Drinkware:** Insulated flasks, temperature tumblers, and sport bottles.
- **Conference Folders:** Executive leather portfolios and zippered folders for boardrooms and conventions.
- **Bags & Luggage:** Leather laptop messengers, ergonomic commuter backpacks, natural jute totes, and felt accessories.
